title: L.B. Foster: Keeping You Cool at Rail Live 2026
summary: We are pleased to confirm our return to Rail Live 2026, the UK’s largest outdoor rail exhibition. This year, we will showcase a comprehensive portfolio of advanced rail technologies engineered to deliver reliable performance in the most demanding operating environments.
body_markdown:
In keeping with the outdoor nature of the event and our ongoing commitment to visitor wellbeing, our stand will also offer complimentary baseball caps, refreshments and ice creams, available on a first-come, first-served basis. To further enhance visitor comfort, our stand will feature a high‑wattage cooling fan, providing welcome relief during warmer conditions—and should the weather change, we will be prepared with a shelter.


We invite you to visit **stand B20** to explore our latest innovations, engage directly with our L.B. Foster experts, and discuss partnership opportunities tailored to your operational needs.


**Event Information**


-


**Dates:** 17–18 June 2026


-


**Venue:** Long Marston Rail Innovation Centre, Station Road, Wilmcote, Stratford‑upon‑Avon, CV37 8PL, United Kingdom


-


**Stand:** B20


-


**Register to attend:**[https://invt.io/1exbu82vyjy](https://invt.io/1exbu82vyjy)


Our Rail Live 2026 showcase highlights **research‑led innovation** , **advanced Friction Management technologies, intelligent monitoring systems,** and **data‑driven insights** designed to support safer, more efficient rail operations.


L.B. Foster solutions are globally recognised for their ability to help rail and light rail operators:


-


**Reduce** maintenance costs, operational and infrastructure risks, fuel & energy consumption, risk of derailments, noise pollution, vibration, environmental footprint.


-


**Improve** passenger communication and safety


-


**Extend** asset life


## Demonstrators on Display


##


[PROTECTOR® Gauge Face Lubrication Systems](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/gauge-face-and-wheel-flange-lubrication/trackside-gauge-face-lubrication) **** offer unsurpassed performance, reliability, and ease of maintenance in both gauge face and top of rail friction management applications.


##


The PW offers many advantages over mechanical lubrication providing an economic and effective method for distributing grease to the rail. Click here to learn more.


##


The product goes where the vehicle goes.[KELTRACK® On-Board](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/top-of-rail-and-wheel-tread-friction-management/keltrack-on-board) (KOB) is a mobile top-of-rail application system. This advanced technology is installed onboard a freight locomotive (KOB) or passenger vehicle (KOB SL) and applies KELTRACK® friction modifiers to the wheel/rail interface.


##


[KELSAN ® Solid Stick Friction Management Solution](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/gauge-face-and-wheel-flange-lubrication/wheel-flange-lubrication) **** - the world's leading system for reducing wear at the wheel/ rail interface. Available for wheel flange lubrication and top-of-rail/wheel thread treatment.


##


L.B. Foster's[TGA3 Traction Gel Applicator system](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/traction-enhancement) works with our **ALLEVIATE®** **Rail Traction Enhancer** to deliver reliable adhesion enhancement in all operating environments - from year-round low adhesion trouble spots, autumn's treacherous leaf fall to boosting productivity in underground mining operations.


##


Maximise grease pick-up and carry-down while reducing waste. L.B. Foster’s patented[gauge face (GF) grease applicator bars](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/gauge-face-and-wheel-flange-lubrication/trackside-gauge-face-lubrication) are the industry standard, combining effective placement of lubricant to the gauge face / wheel flange interface with long life cycle value.


##


[KELTRACK AP EX](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/top-of-rail-and-wheel-tread-friction-management/trackside-top-of-rail-friction-management) **** is a premium water-based top-of-rail friction modifier, that contains no oil and provides intermediate friction levels between the wheel and rail. It has a very low environmental impact, using latest technology in environmentally friendly raw material components.


##


Our gauge face grease portfolio starts with[SYNCURVE™ Transit](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/lbfoster-fuchs) , an exceedingly durable all-season rail curve lubricant giving the customer flexibility of either employing a lower application rate for existing spaced lubricators (up to 50% lower) or increasing lubricator spacing using current application rates. SYNCURVE™ Transit provides excellent protection in the wheel flange/gauge face interface and is ultimately biodegradable.


##


With more than 100 years of engineering excellence, we bring deep industry knowledge to every project—designing, manufacturing, upgrading, and maintaining[Signalling Control Panels](https://lbfoster.com/rail/technology-solutions/electrical-solutions/rail-signalling-control-systems) that meet the demands of modern rail operations.


##


Innovation meets reliability. Our integrated software and[award-winning Customer Information Displays](https://lbfoster.com/rail/technology-solutions/digital-solutions/rail-and-transport/inform-customer-information-display-solutions) **** combine cutting-edge technology with user-focused interface to deliver real-time travel information and safer, smarter journeys.
